channels.name: h431_analytic_signal
channels.note: sqrt(tmi_hg^2 + tmi_vg^2): contact locator independent of magnetization direction

channels.name: h431_asa_ridge
channels.note: non-max-suppressed ridge of the analytic signal amplitude

channels.name: h431_tilt_grad
channels.note: |grad tc|: the horizontal gradient of the tilt angle peaks over source edges

channels.name: h431_tilt_zero_band
channels.note: narrow band around the tilt-angle zero contour, which outlines the source body

channels.name: line_mag
channels.note: Frangi vesselness (both polarities) of tmi at sigma=(1.2, 2.5), 0.5/99.5 pct

channels.name: line_rtp
channels.note: Frangi vesselness (both polarities) of rtp at sigma=(1.2, 2.5), 0.5/99.5 pct

channels.name: line_tilt
channels.note: Frangi vesselness (both polarities) of tc at sigma=(1.2, 2.5), 0.5/99.5 pct

channels.name: line_grav
channels.note: Frangi vesselness (both polarities) of iso_grav_anom at sigma=(1.5, 3.0), 0.5/99.5 pct

channels.name: line_elev
channels.note: Frangi vesselness (both polarities) of det_elev at sigma=(1.2, 2.5), 0.5/99.5 pct

channels.name: line_cond
channels.note: Frangi vesselness (both polarities) of cond_surf at sigma=(1.5, 3.0), 0.5/99.5 pct

channels.name: line_base
channels.note: Frangi vesselness (both polarities) of depth_to_base_surf at sigma=(1.5, 3.0), 0.5/99.5 pct

channels.name: line_shear
channels.note: Frangi vesselness (both polarities) of geod_shearrate at sigma=(2.0, 4.0), 0.5/99.5 pct

channels.name: h431_orient_order
channels.note: R = |sum_p w_p exp(2i theta_p)| / sum_p w_p over ['mag', 'rtp', 'tilt', 'grav', 'elev', 'cond', 'base']: do independent physics agree on the strike?

channels.name: h431_multi_physics_fused
channels.note: OR-fusion of the per-physics line responses, gated by strike agreement

channels.name: h432_base_step
channels.note: |grad depth_to_base_surf|: a step in the sedimentary cover thickness = basin fault

channels.name: h432_cond_step
channels.note: |grad log cond_surf|: MT conductivity step = buried lithologic/fluid boundary

channels.name: h432_coincidence
channels.note: geometric mean of basement step, conductivity step and geodetic shear ridge

channels.name: h432_conceal_gate
channels.note: 1 - mean(local relief, local slope): high where no scarp could be mapped

channels.name: h432_concealed_coincidence
channels.note: subsurface coincidence weighted by the concealment gate

channels.name: h433_seis_resid
channels.note: |ieq - smooth(ieq, 12 px)|: the supplied band is 0.9935 self-correlated at 3 km, so only the high-pass residual can carry fault-scale information

channels.name: h433_deq_min
channels.note: negative distance-to-earthquake: local minima line up along active structures

channels.name: h435_grav_analytic_signal
channels.note: analytic signal amplitude of the isostatic gravity anomaly

channels.name: h435_grav_tilt_depth
channels.note: tilt-depth SPI: 1/|grad(tilt)| estimates depth to the density contrast

channels.name: ext_sgmc_prox
channels.note: exp(-d/400 m) to the SGMC fault inventory (an independent compilation)

channels.name: h434_spring_density
channels.note: GDR well/spring density weighted by measured temperature

channels.name: h434_spring_lines
channels.note: locality-constrained PCA lineaments through clusters of >=3 thermal features (radius 25 px, elongation >= 0.80), extended 12 px along strike: orientation evidence that an isotropic proximity decay cannot express

channels.name: ext_vent_prox
channels.note: exp(-d/800 m) to GDR volcanic vents
